name: llama.cpp
license: MIT (LICENSE in the archive, https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/b11655/LICENSE). Upstream's Ubuntu x64 CPU build: it picks the CPU variant at run time (libggml-cpu-*.so), needs glibc 2.34, libstdc++, libgomp and OpenSSL 3, and finds its libraries through RUNPATH $ORIGIN. GitHub publishes the same SHA-256 as the asset's digest. b11655 is e36df60, the commit the OCR evaluation built, plus a Vulkan-only fix (docs/architecture/photo-ocr.md).
